title: K-pop Royalty Recruited for PlayStation Korea's Glitzy GTA 6 Ad
text: K-pop Royalty Recruited for PlayStation Korea's Glitzy GTA 6 Ad | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Sony PS5 GTA Korea K-pop Royalty Recruited for PlayStation Korea's Glitzy GTA 6 Ad The wait is over by Sammy Barker 4 hours ago Share: Image: PlayStation Korea One thing I always appreciate about PlayStation is its ability to appeal to localised audiences, despite its message being unified globally. The company’s current marketing strategy revolves around GTA 6 , and it’s using the slogan ‘ Plays Best on PS5 ’. But it’s promoting this in a variety of ways around the world. Its Korean commercial is particularly glitzy, featuring K-pop royalty like Jay Park and members from girl group QWER . The cinematic trailer revolves around the 13-year wait since GTA 5 . In the video, the city lights go down and the aforementioned celebs all rush home to power up the game – on the PS5, of course. It’s a fun ad, and it’s interesting to see Sony invest so much into a bespoke commercial like this. 기다림은 끝났다. 모두가 기다려 온 그 순간이 다가옵니다. 최강록 셰프, 박재범, 오율&률(LNGSHOT), 쵸단&마젠타(QWER), 그리고 성승헌 캐스터까지! 서로 다른 일상을 보내던 이들이 갑자기 한곳으로 향하기 시작한 이유는? 대한민국에서만 진행된 Grand Theft Auto VI 특별 영상을 확인하세요.… pic.twitter.com/9pLYmz34f4 - PlayStation Korea (@SIEK_PlayGround) November 12, 2026 It’s particularly amusing seeing as the Rockstar open world was almost denied release in South Korea , due to its inclusion of “out of context” nudity. Of course, it’s targeted marketing like this that’s made PlayStation a powerhouse around the globe, and will help ensure GTA 6 sells best on Sony’s box by some margin.
